features.summary: Every CLI command honours the 0/1/2/130 exit-code contract.
A narrative becomes an approved incubator.json with at most 5 questions per round and 2 rounds.
An existing repository plus a change request becomes a plan, tickets and design briefs on a branch, without modifying any existing file.
A new solution or an update is built in a folder the owner chose; the owner approves the commit and the push at the end of the coding iteration.
